question: Can a fixed 260-byte online learner preserve useful unary predictions when rejecting an unsupported two-parent relationship, while retaining true two-parent learning and rejecting unrelated/random causal claims?
hypothesis: Hierarchical 0/1/2-parent selection, with fit-only candidate selection and independent within-training validation, improves macro out-of-family held Brier at least 0.045 against Gate11's pair-only calibrated learner while maintaining true two-parent Brier degradation <=0.015, recovering >=90% true parent pairs and >=90% unary links, rejecting >=90% each of unrepresentable parity3, random and biased-independent worlds. Equal-state fit-end hierarchical fixed is decisive structural control; a tie forbids structural self-assembly advantage.

data.origin: original deterministic synthetic source, no external data
data.intervention_policy: six independent uniform bits from xorshift32(seed), shared across learners and controls; 128 fit then immutable 32 held per context; no held updates
data.worlds: Pair worlds choose two distinct parents and one 2-bit truth table depending on both parents; unary uses one input or its negation; parity3 uses 3 distinct input XOR; random has independent fair bits; biased-independent returns Bernoulli(0.8) independent of input. Independent 5% noise on all except random and biased-independent. Hidden source parents and operator are visible only to evaluator, never to learner.

methods.local_state: Per context, 64 latest training (intervention uint8, label uint8) observations plus 1 route byte and 1 accepted/order flag =130 bytes; 2 contexts =260 serialized bytes. Route 0=null, 1..6 unary, 7..21 unordered pair. Route is selected from only training examples. Scratch computations excluded and reported separately.
methods.fit_partition: For each selection scan, use oldest 48 of last 64 observations as candidate-fit data, newest 16 as independent within-training validation. At 32 observations use 16 fit + 16 validation. Fit fixed parameter-free Laplace conditional Bernoulli p=(positives+1)/(count+2), clipped [0.05,0.95].
methods.selection: Search best of 1 marginal null, 6 one-parent candidates, 15 two-parent candidates using fit-only Brier plus absolute complexity penalties order0=0, order1=0.015, order2=0.045, tie by order 0 then index. Validation must improve over marginal null by >=0.05 for unary or >=0.08 for pair, otherwise choose order0. Two-parent additionally requires an empirical absolute conditional-probability contrast >=0.40 for each parent in at least one stratum, both corresponding bins >=3 samples. All proposal selection independent of 16 validation labels. Marginal null always predicts Laplace context frequency, not fixed 0.5.
methods.hierarchical_dynamic: Rescan at 32,64,96,128 training observations in each context, final scan determines route; rewire count and work recorded.
methods.hierarchical_fixed: Identical selection, same 260-byte serialized state, same observations; only one scan at 128. This is the decisive equal-final-evidence fixed comparator, and final held predictions are expected to tie dynamic. No scientific superiority of dynamics can be claimed on a tie.
methods.gate11_pair_calibrated: Original Gate11 pair-only fitted selector reimplemented verbatim: choose among 15 pair candidates by first48 empirical fitted Brier, validate last16 improvement over null >=0.08 and each-parent contrast >=0.45; return last64 pair table if accepted else Laplace marginal. Same 260-byte allocation. Used as calibrated predecessor baseline on entirely NEW seeds.
methods.marginal_null: Predict Laplace context marginal frequency from last64 labels, ignore interventions, no structural claim.
methods.bayesian_0_1_2_plus_null: Fitted posterior over 3 order-zero hypotheses [fair coin, constant-zero noise .05, constant-one noise .05], 12 unary bit/complement hypotheses and 150 non-unary binary truth tables across 15 parent pairs; prior 1/3 per order, uniform within order, 5% known flip noise. 165 log posterior float64 entries per context (2640 nominal bytes), unmatched, posterior mean held Brier. 0.8 biased independent not exactly represented, a declared misspecification.

controls: Gate11 calibrated pair-only on fresh identical data
fair random and biased-independent negative worlds
metrics: held Brier by five methods, each family
zero-order abstention for parity3/random/biased independent /64 each
per-seed paired 95% normal CI of macro OOD Brier gain and in-family loss
matched hierarchical fixed identical held outputs
cold prediction bitwise equality after 260-byte pack/reconstitute
candidate evaluation counts, wall-time diagnostics separately

predetermined_success.for_structural_superiority: requires >=0.02 held Brier gain vs equal 260-byte hierarchical fixed and 95% paired CI excludes zero; tie or regression is NO_GO on structural advantage
predetermined_success.interpretation: Passing these requirements only demonstrates synthetic model-order selection and calibration; NEVER native intelligence, autonomy, general causal discovery or accepted Yggdrasil improvement.

negative_or_mixed: Report ALL thresholds without tuning. If any calibration requirement fails, SCIENTIFIC_NEGATIVE_DEV or MIXED. If hierarchical dynamic ties fixed, mark structural superiority FAIL even if calibration gates pass. If a protocol or source bug is discovered, document before/after timing; no changing seeds/thresholds/model after viewing primary outcomes.
source_identity_fence: Commit this prereg before source execution; commit source before any primary results, then preserve source/result SHA and exact GitHub CI receipts.
